[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Moment: An app that tracks phone usage and allows setting daily limits and blocking access during certain hours.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Screen Time: A built-in feature on iOS devices that tracks app usage and allows setting daily limits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Digital Wellbeing: A built-in feature on Android devices that tracks app usage and allows setting daily limits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the following browser extensions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. uBlock Origin: A browser extension that blocks social media during set periods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. LeechBlock: A Firefox extension that blocks social media during set periods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the following other tools:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. SelfControl: A free, open-source app for Mac that blocks distracting websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. FocalFilter: A Windows app that blocks distracting websites during set periods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for limiting social media usage:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Schedule regular breaks to check social media.
